$Comment: Extends a jar-shipped ActionAsset additively via the BARE Target:{Action} form (an Action target accepts PerCycleContributions/Bonus/Conversions/Steps/Anchors plus per-leaf Puppet/Custody/ContributionScale overlays; the Station target carries only an Actions append). Bare is deliberate here, unlike SawmillProgression.json's station-scoped {Station, Action}: prepfish is a standalone ActionAsset that several stations Ref, and this XP should follow the ritual wherever it runs rather than one station's copy of it. RPG Stations' own jar ships a standalone, zero-progression fish layer (Actions/PrepFish.json, the 'prepfish' action referenced here, plus its Stations/CuttingBoard.json and Stations/CookingFire.json anchors); this file is the only thing that makes COOKING skill XP flow from it, additively, without owning or replacing PrepFish.json. Posts to the same mmoskilltree:skill_xp channel SawmillProgression.json uses (Param = skill id), with no double-count risk here: Cooking has no other progression source anywhere, jar or pack, so this PerCycleContributions array is the skill's entire progression path. RPG Stations forwards Work.PerCycleContributions verbatim, filtered by channel and unresolved on its own side (StationCycleCompletedEvent.contributions()); the MMO bridge reads Param as the skill id for this channel only, so no MMO-side code change was needed here. Smithing's feature-gate precedent applies unchanged (COOKING exists only with this pack installed, per its own CustomSkills/Cooking.json RequiresFeatures).
